subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: Should the OpenRouter plugin publish its credential-scoped live catalog into shared model-list and picker surfaces while preserving agents.defaults.models as the final allowlist?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the implementation seam, but filtering, credential scope, refresh cadence, stale/offline behavior, metadata trust, and whether the broad catalog appears by default are product and security policy choices.

options.title: Provider-owned live catalog
options.body: Add cached OpenRouter catalog augmentation with a curated default view, explicit full-list browsing, static offline fallback, and unchanged allowlist authority.

options.title: Keep runtime-only discovery
options.body: Retain arbitrary runtime model resolution but leave browsing curated/static, then narrow or close this issue in favor of specific provider-listing requests.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned live catalog
recommendation.body: Add cached OpenRouter catalog augmentation with a curated default view, explicit full-list browsing, static offline fallback, and unchanged allowlist authority.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the merger and follow-up ownership of OpenRouter's existing dynamic-resolution path.
